canonical_name: User Datagram Protocol — RFC 768 / STD 6 core
addressing: Uses transport port numbers above IP-layer addressing.
routing_or_forwarding: No routing function; carried by IP.
error_control: Checksum mechanism; no retransmission or reliability service in UDP itself.
flow_or_congestion_control: No built-in connection, flow-control or ordering machinery.

survival.provenance_notes: The old minimal transport abstraction remains in active use.

open_questions: Build RFC 768 → later update matrix including checksum-related revisions.
Trace major application families that deliberately chose UDP.
Separate UDP wire continuity from application-level reliability/congestion mechanisms built above it.

sources.locator: RFC Editor metadata; RFC 768 Introduction and format

related_artifacts.relation: carried by IPv4 among other IP versions

notes: Reference example of durability through minimal responsibility rather than feature accumulation.
